value: Statement I true, Statement II false
reasoning: Statement I: \(3N\) is a multiple of 3, so \(3N+2\) leaves remainder 2. True. Statement II: N leaves remainder 3 on division by 5, so it ends in 3 or 8; N is even, so it ends in 8 (e.g. 8, 18, 28). Dividing by 10 leaves remainder 8, not 4. False.

I: exterior angles of a triangle add to \(360^\circ\), double the interior sum \(180^\circ\). True. II: interior sum \(= 2 \times 360^\circ = 720^\circ\), so \((n-2) \times 180^\circ = 720^\circ\) gives \(n = 6\), a hexagon. True. III: interior angles are \(30^\circ, 60^\circ, 90^\circ\), so exterior angles are \(150^\circ, 120^\circ, 90^\circ\), in the ratio \(5 : 4 : 3\), not \(3 : 2 : 1\). False.
The work is \(7 \times 16 = 112\) man-days, so double the work is 224 man-days. To finish it in 8 days needs \(224 \div 8 = 28\) men.
Total marbles \(= 6 + 5 + 4 + 5 = 20\), of which 6 are red. Probability \(= \frac{6}{20} = \frac{3}{10}\).
The primes from 1 to 16 are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13: six of them. Probability \(= \frac{6}{16} = \frac{3}{8}\).

Cost \(= 160 \times 50 = ₹8000\). 70% of 160 kg is 112 kg sold at ₹70, giving ₹7840; the other 48 kg at ₹35 gives ₹1680. Selling price \(= ₹9520\), gain \(= ₹1520\), and \(\frac{1520}{8000} \times 100 = 19\%\).
Multiply the ratio by 18: \(a : b : c = 6 : 3 : 2\). Then \(\frac{a^2+b^2}{b^2-c^2} = \frac{36+9}{9-4} = \frac{45}{5} = 9\).
Selling price \(= 1500 \times 0.95 = ₹1425\). This is 125% of the cost, so cost \(= 1425 \div 1.25 = ₹1140\).
The food is \(200 \times 42 = 8400\) person-days. With 240 persons it lasts \(8400 \div 240 = 35\) days.

value: Table A not in direct proportion; Table B is in direct proportion (no option says this as printed)
runnerUp: A, which as printed says exactly the same thing as C
reasoning: In Table A, \(\frac{y}{x}\) is 4, 4, 3, 3, 4, so x and y are not in direct proportion. In Table B, \(\frac{y}{x}\) is 6 every time, so they are in direct proportion. No option says this: as printed, options A and C say the same thing (neither table is proportional), so the item looks defective. Option C was most likely meant to read "in table B, x and y are in direct proportion".
For a fixed distance, a higher speed means less time, and speed \(\times\) time stays constant. So speed and time vary inversely. The other pairs increase together (direct variation).
LCM of 6, 5, 7, 10 and 12 is 420, so the bells toll together every 420 seconds. One hour is 3600 seconds, and \(3600 \div 420 = 8.57\), so they toll together 8 times after the start.
Lateral surface area \(= 4a^2 = 256\), so \(a^2 = 64\) and \(a = 8\) m. Volume \(= 8^3 = 512 \text{ m}^3\).

Euler's formula: \(F + V - E = 2\), so \(40 + V - 60 = 2\) and \(V = 22\).
Two years of 5% growth multiplies the population by \(1.05^2 = 1.1025\). So the 2003 population \(= 66150 \div 1.1025 = 60000\). Check: \(60000 \to 63000 \to 66150\).

1 year 9 months \(= \frac{7}{4}\) years, so interest \(= P \times \frac{25}{3} \times \frac{7}{4} \div 100 = \frac{7P}{48}\). Amount \(= \frac{55P}{48} = 2475\), so \(P = ₹2160\). At 5% for 2 years, interest \(= 10\%\) of 2160 \(= 216\), amount \(= ₹2376\).

Look at the small triangle formed by the slanting line, the right side of the big triangle and the base. Its angle at the crossing point is e, and its angle on the base at the far right is \(180^\circ - g\) (g is the exterior angle there). Angle c is the exterior angle of this small triangle at the vertex on the base, so it equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles: \(c = e + (180^\circ - g)\).
